# Feature glossary

[:arrow_left: Documentation index](index.md)

<!-- Generated by tools/make_feature_glossary.py from feature_dictionary.py; do not edit by hand. -->

Every column of the feature tables, what it measures, how it is computed and when it is left empty. The same definitions are written into every run as `features/feature_dictionary.json`. For the method behind them see [How it works](theory.md); for interpretation see [Interpreting results](concepts.md).

## How to read the tables

- **Column names.** In the feature tables, every feature column carries the name of the analysed object set: `Nuclei__speed_xy_median` with a foreground (the name is yours to choose), `whole__speed_xy_median` without one (MorphoBricks naming). Quality-control columns (`qc_*`) have no prefix. The tables below give the column without its prefix.
- **Per frame and per field of view.** `features_per_frame.csv` holds one row per analysed time point `t` of every field of view. `features_per_fov.csv` holds one row per field of view with the **same column names**: each value is the mean over that field of view's time points (the circular mean for directions in degrees), with undefined time points left out, never counted as 0. The field of view is the observation unit of the statistics.
- **Units.** *speed unit* is µm/min when the pixel size and frame interval are confirmed, otherwise pixel/frame; *axial speed unit* is µm/min with a confirmed Z spacing and frame interval, otherwise slice/frame. The unit of a run is written in `feature_dictionary.json` (`units`).
- **Use.** *readout*: given to MorphoCoverage. *axial readout (experimental)*: given to MorphoCoverage only when you include axial features. *orientation descriptor*: depends on how the image is oriented, never a readout. *quality control*: metadata, never a readout.
- **Undefined.** An empty cell is a value that does not exist (for example a coefficient of variation when the mean speed is 0). The reason is recorded per row in `undefined_features` of `features_per_frame.csv`. Undefined values are never set to 0.
- **Speeds.** Optical-flow speeds are the motion of intensity patterns, with a size-dependent gain bias documented in [Validation](validation.md); they are not tracked nuclear displacements.

## Speed

How fast the intensity patterns move. One family is computed per run: `speed_xy_*` with XY speed (the default) or `speed_3d_*` with 3D speed (`speed_mode = xyz`, experimental because the axial component is less reliable in shallow stacks).

| Column | What it measures | How it is computed | Unit | Use | Undefined (empty) when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed_xy_mean` | Mean speed over analysed voxels. Optical-flow speed: intensity-pattern motion, with the gain bias documented in docs/validation.md; not a calibrated nuclear displacement. | `s = sqrt(vx²+vy²) per voxel (scaled per axis); mean(s)` | speed unit | readout | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `speed_xy_median` | Median speed over analysed voxels. Optical-flow speed: intensity-pattern motion, with the gain bias documented in docs/validation.md; not a calibrated nuclear displacement. | `s = sqrt(vx²+vy²) per voxel (scaled per axis); median(s)` | speed unit | readout | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `speed_xy_sd` | Standard deviation of speed over analysed voxels. Optical-flow speed: intensity-pattern motion, with the gain bias documented in docs/validation.md; not a calibrated nuclear displacement. | `s = sqrt(vx²+vy²) per voxel (scaled per axis); std(s), ddof=0` | speed unit | readout | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `speed_xy_cv` | Coefficient of variation of speed over analysed voxels. Optical-flow speed: intensity-pattern motion, with the gain bias documented in docs/validation.md; not a calibrated nuclear displacement. | `s = sqrt(vx²+vy²) per voxel (scaled per axis); std(s)/mean(s)` | none (ratio) | readout | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion); cv: mean speed is zero |
| `speed_xy_rms` | Root-mean-square speed over analysed voxels. Optical-flow speed: intensity-pattern motion, with the gain bias documented in docs/validation.md; not a calibrated nuclear displacement. | `s = sqrt(vx²+vy²) per voxel (scaled per axis); sqrt(mean(s²))` | speed unit | readout | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `speed_xy_p10` | 10th percentile of speed over analysed voxels. Optical-flow speed: intensity-pattern motion, with the gain bias documented in docs/validation.md; not a calibrated nuclear displacement. | `s = sqrt(vx²+vy²) per voxel (scaled per axis); percentile(s, 10)` | speed unit | readout | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `speed_xy_p25` | 25th percentile of speed over analysed voxels. ## Velocity components

The X, Y and Z components of the velocity separately. Signed means depend on how the image is oriented; spreads and absolute values do not.

| Column | What it measures | How it is computed | Unit | Use | Undefined (empty) when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vx_mean` | Mean signed vx. Depends on image orientation; not comparable between differently oriented images. | `mean(vx)` | speed unit | orientation descriptor | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `vy_mean` | Mean signed vy (y down). Depends on image orientation; not comparable between differently oriented images. | `mean(vy)` | speed unit | orientation descriptor | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `vz_mean` | Mean signed vz. Depends on image orientation; not comparable between differently oriented images. | `mean(vz)` | axial speed unit | orientation descriptor | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `vx_sd` | Standard deviation of vx. Depends on image orientation; not comparable between differently oriented images. | `std(vx)` | speed unit | orientation descriptor | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `vy_sd` | Standard deviation of vy. Depends on image orientation; not comparable between differently oriented images. | `std(vy)` | speed unit | orientation descriptor | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `vz_sd` | Standard deviation of vz. | `std(vz)` | axial speed unit | axial readout (experimental) | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `vx_abs_mean` | Mean absolute vx. Depends on image orientation; not comparable between differently oriented images. | `mean(\|vx\|)` | speed unit | orientation descriptor | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `vy_abs_mean` | Mean absolute vy. Depends on image orientation; not comparable between differently oriented images. | `mean(\|vy\|)` | speed unit | orientation descriptor | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `vz_abs_mean` | Mean absolute vz. | `mean(\|vz\|)` | axial speed unit | axial readout (experimental) | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `lateral_speed_mean` | Mean XY speed (in XY mode this is speed_xy_mean). | `mean(sqrt(vx²+vy²))` | speed unit | readout | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion) |
| `axial_lateral_ratio` | Axial versus lateral motion. | `mean(\|vz\|)/mean(sqrt(vx²+vy²))` | none (ratio) | axial readout (experimental) | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion); lateral speed zero; lateral and axial units differ |

## Collective motion and direction

Whether neighbouring and distant nuclei move together, and how directions are spread. The angular features use only vectors whose XY speed exceeds `min_direction_speed`, and need at least `min_direction_vectors` of them.

| Column | What it measures | How it is computed | Unit | Use | Undefined (empty) when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `coherence_xy_global` | Global XY directional coherence (1 = all vectors parallel, 0 = no net direction), speed weighted. | `\|Σ(vx,vy)\| / Σ\|(vx,vy)\|` | none (ratio) | readout | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion); all analysed vectors are zero |
| `coherence_3d_global` | Global 3D directional coherence. | `\|Σ(vx,vy,vz)\| / Σ\|(vx,vy,vz)\|` | none (ratio) | axial readout (experimental) | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion); all analysed vectors are zero; units differ |
| `coherence_xy_local` | Mean local XY coherence in a square XY window (local_window_px) of the same slice; windows with fewer than min_local_vectors analysed nonzero vectors are left out. | `mean over analysed voxels of \|Σ_window v\| / Σ_window \|v\|` | none (ratio) | readout | no analysed voxel (empty foreground or nothing passes the reliability criterion); no window with min_local_vectors analysed nonzero vectors |
| `xy_angular_entropy` | Normalised entropy of a smooth density of XY directions (1 = uniform, 0 = one direction): a wrapped-normal kernel density with a standard deviation of 360°/angle_bins. No bins or anchor, so rotating the image does not change it and a small change of one direction changes it a little. | `(H - H_kernel) / (log 2π - H_kernel), H = -∫ p log p dθ of the kernel density` | none (ratio) | readout | fewer than min_direction_vectors analysed vectors with XY speed > min_direction_speed |
| `xy_angular_dispersion` | Circular variance of XY directions, unweighted (0 = aligned, 1 = no mean direction). | `1 - \|mean(exp(iθ))\|` | none (ratio) | readout | fewer than min_direction_vectors analysed vectors with XY speed > min_direction_speed |
| `xy_aligned_fraction` | Fraction of directed XY vectors within aligned_angle_deg of the dominant direction. | `mean(cos(θ-θ_dom) >= cos(aligned_angle_deg))` | none (ratio) | readout | fewer than min_direction_vectors analysed vectors with XY speed > min_direction_speed; mean resultant zero |
| `xy_dominant_direction_deg` | Dominant XY direction (image coordinates, y down). Depends on image orientation; not comparable between differently oriented images. Not a MorphoCoverage feature. | `atan2(mean sinθ, mean cosθ)` | degree | orientation descriptor | fewer than min_direction_vectors analysed vectors with XY speed > min_direction_speed; mean resultant zero |

## Spatial heterogeneity

How different the motion is between regions of the field of view: the image is cut into square regions of `region_size_px` pixels and each full region with at least `min_region_voxels` analysed voxels gets its own speed and coherence.

| Column | What it measures | How it is computed | Unit | Use | Undefined (empty) when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `regional_speed_cv` | Variation of mean speed between fixed square XY regions (region_size_px, all Z). | `std(R)/mean(R), R = region mean speeds` | none (ratio) | readout | fewer than 2 full regions with min_region_voxels analysed voxels |
| `regional_speed_spread` | Regional speed heterogeneity. | `(P90(R)-P10(R))/median(R)` | none (ratio) | readout | fewer than 2 full regions with min_region_voxels analysed voxels |
| `regional_coherence_sd` | Variation of directional coherence between regions. | `std of region \|Σv\|/Σ\|v\| (XY)` | none (ratio) | readout | fewer than 2 full regions with min_region_voxels analysed voxels |
| `regional_moving_fraction` | Fraction of regions whose mean speed exceeds motion_threshold. | `mean(R > motion_threshold)` | none (ratio) | readout | motion_threshold not set; no region |

## Quality control

Metadata that qualify a measurement (reliability, coverage, object sizes, brightness change). They are never given to MorphoCoverage as features; use them to check that conditions are comparable.

| Column | What it measures | How it is computed | Unit | Use | Undefined (empty) when |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `qc_reliability_threshold` | Reliability threshold applied in this frame. | `absolute value, or percentile of foreground reliability` | reliability | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_reliability_median` | Median reliability in the foreground (before filtering). | `median(rel)` | reliability | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_reliability_p10` | 10th percentile of foreground reliability. | `percentile` | reliability | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_reliability_p90` | 90th percentile of foreground reliability. | `percentile` | reliability | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_reliable_fraction` | Fraction of finite foreground voxels passing the reliability criterion. | `n(reliable)/n(finite foreground)` | none (ratio) | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_invalid_velocity_fraction` | Fraction of foreground voxels with a non-finite velocity component. | `n(non-finite)/n(foreground)` | none (ratio) | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_foreground_fraction` | Fraction of the volume in the foreground (occupancy). | `mean(foreground)` | none (ratio) | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_n_analysed_voxels` | Number of analysed voxels. | `count` | voxel | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_n_regions` | Number of full regions of the grid. | `count` | region | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_n_regions_analysed` | Regions with enough analysed voxels. | `count` | region | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_region_grid_coverage` | Fraction of the XY image covered by full regions (partial edge regions are left out). | `n_regions·region_size² / (Y·X)` | none (ratio) | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_brightness_change_per_frame` | Global brightness change across the optical-flow time window (illumination, focus, bleaching or expression). Optical flow reads part of a brightness change as motion; values above 0.02 are flagged. | `least-squares slope of the window frames' mean raw intensity / central frame's mean` | 1/frame | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_invalid_reliability_fraction` | Fraction of finite-velocity foreground voxels with non-finite reliability (never reliable, never used to set a threshold). | `n(non-finite rel)/n(finite foreground)` | none (ratio) | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_foreground_intensity_mean` | Mean raw intensity in the foreground (confounder; undefined without a foreground). | `mean(I)` | raw intensity | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_object_mean_voxels` | Mean size of connected foreground objects (confounder of the optical-flow gain). | `mean voxel count of 3D connected components` | voxel | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_object_mean_z_extent` | Mean Z extent of foreground objects (confounder of the axial gain). | `mean slice span of components` | slice | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
| `qc_n_objects` | Number of connected foreground objects. | `count` | object | quality control | no foreground voxel, or input not supplied |
